steps.en: Install the three libraries the scripts are built on
steps.zh: 装上脚本依赖的三个库

steps.en: Run the one site's script and type your account and password at the prompt
steps.zh: 运行目标网站那一个脚本，按提示输入账号和密码

steps.en: Loads the login page and scrapes the one-time token the form needs
steps.zh: 打开登录页，抠出表单要用的一次性令牌

steps.en: Posts the credentials as the site's page would (some scripts RSA-encrypt the password first)
steps.zh: 照网页的方式提交账号密码（部分脚本先用 RSA 加密密码）

steps.en: If the site asks for a captcha, read the image it opens and type it in
steps.zh: 网站要验证码时，看它弹出的图片，手动输入

steps.en: Saves the logged-in session cookies to a local file for the next run
steps.zh: 把登录后的会话 cookie 存进本地文件，下次直接用

value.en: A readable worked example of replaying one site's 2016–2018 login over raw HTTP — not a login that still works
value.zh: 一份看得懂的样例：怎样用裸 HTTP 重放某网站 2016–2018 年的登录——而不是一个今天还能登上的工具

sources: https://github.com/xchaoinfo/fuck-login#readme (not maintained notice 2018.06.08; requests 处理登录, pillow 处理验证码, rsa 处理加密问题; per-site list)

https://github.com/xchaoinfo/fuck-login/blob/master/001%20zhihu/zhihu.py (input account/password; get_xsrf scrapes _xsrf; session.post login; get_captcha shows captcha.jpg via PIL and reads input; session.cookies.save() to LWPCookieJar 'cookies')
